title: Stuck watch and steer for claude-sub container jobs on a hosted deployment
description:
The stuck watch and the steer route live in the WorkerAgent. A claude-sub job on a hosted deployment runs in its own container with no agent, so a steer gets 409 not_conversing and nothing nudges or stops a silent claude worker before its wall or harness_budget_ms. Either watch container jobs from the state route's log cursor, or make the Go side's watch treat not_conversing on a rung job as expected.
evidence: cloudflare/src/sandbox-dispatch.ts:921 steerAgent; cloudflare/src/sandbox-executor.ts startContainerAttempt (no stuck_seconds consumer)
